name: sheleg-dev
description: Seven integration skills for the layer a product reaches once it has users: money in, tracking, errors, sign-in, and speed.

plugins.name: sheleg-dev
plugins.description: The integration layer a product needs once it has users: Stripe subscription billing reconciled into your own database, crypto payments that survive over-payment and duplicate webhooks, ad and conversion tracking under Consent Mode v2, Google sign-in with the account-linking guards, the wider Google auth surface, and Core Web Vitals work that moves the score, and Sentry error tracking wired so it does not forward your own credentials to a third party and so a stack trace names the commit that caused it.
